item.title: LAX Sees Large Number of Flight Delays, Cancellations

item.title: Southland Rain Expected to Continue Through Monday
item.description: Southern California’s long run of rainy days is expected to continue Monday before dry skies return Tuesday, according to the National Weather Service.
